# MVP-0 Replay Fixtures

This directory is the only GitHub-allowed replay fixture location for MVP-0.

Fixtures here must be synthetic, redacted, or hand-written minimal examples.
They must not contain raw audio, raw debug traces, secrets, credentials,
unredacted real user input, local replay cache data, or large raw web content.

Local debug artifacts belong under ignored paths such as `diagnostics/`,
`traces/`, `replays/local/`, and `audio/raw/`; do not place them here.
